instruction: Update the slide numbers in LibreOffice Impress so they appear in blue.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the slide number color to blue in LibreOffice Impress. Uses existing check_page_number_colors metric function that checks the slide master's page number color. The evaluator verifies that the slide number color meets the blue threshold (B > R+50 and B > G+50).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the slide number color change requirement
Metric function check_page_number_colors properly extracts color from slide master XML (ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster1.xml)
Color comparison logic is semantically correct using threshold-based blue detection (B > R+50 and B > G+50)
Expected parameter handling is correct: rules dict is passed directly to metric function, accessed as rules['color']
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before extraction, ensuring fresh state

Minor concern: Hardcoded index color_elems[-2] assumes page number color is at second-to-last position in XML, which may be fragile across different PPTX templates but appears to be a known pattern for LibreOffice Impress
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider making the color element selection more robust by searching for page number placeholder elements explicitly rather than relying on hardcoded index -2
Could add validation to check if color_elems has at least 2 elements before accessing [-2] to prevent index errors
